summary: Iteration 171 — BidVex Storage Auctions iter171 backend testing. Validated 4 new endpoint surfaces (public stats, admin deposits dashboard, admin release-deposits, admin forfeit-deposit), scheduler registration (10 jobs, storage_close_job at 5min interval), bilingual winner/sold emails (per-payment-method branching). 21/21 NEW iter171 API tests pass + 10/10 iter170 unit regression tests still pass = 31/31 overall. No critical bugs. One minor contract deviation: send_storage_auction_won_email and send_storage_auction_sold_email are typed `-> bool` but return dict {'status':'logged','message':'SendGrid not configured - email logged'} when SendGrid is not configured (no exception raised, but type hint is wrong).

minor.issue: Return-type signature is `-> bool` but actual SendGrid-not-configured fallback returns a dict {'status':'logged','message':'...'}. No exception raised — but callers expecting bool get a truthy dict. Minor type-hint contract drift.
Pydantic V1 @validator decorators emit DeprecationWarning. Should migrate to @field_validator before V3.0 (carried over from iter170, not new).

action_items: (Minor) Either update return-type hint of send_storage_auction_won_email / send_storage_auction_sold_email from `-> bool` to `-> Union[bool, dict]`, OR change the SendGrid-not-configured branch to return False (and log instead of returning the dict). Current behavior is non-breaking but mismatched.
(Optional, carried) Migrate /app/backend/models/storage_auction.py @validator → @field_validator for Pydantic V2 compliance.
critical_code_review_comments: Public stats endpoint /api/storage-auctions/stats/public correctly returns int-typed zero-safe counts (total_sold, active_facilities, active_auctions, total_bids_placed). No auth needed. ✓

/api/admin/storage-deposits enforces admin RBAC via _require_admin (401 unauth → 403 buyer). Response shape exactly matches spec: {stats:{active_holds,applied,refunded,forfeited}, total, deposits:[…]}. Enrichment via aggregation lookup in routes/storage_auctions.py:898-939 is clean. ✓
status=active filter aliases to {held, authorized} via $in (line 894-897) — correct semantics matching frontend KPI 'Active Holds'. ✓
/api/admin/storage-auctions/{id}/release-deposits returns 404 for unknown auction (line 840-841) and 403 for non-admin via _require_admin. ✓
/api/admin/storage-auctions/{id}/forfeit-deposit returns 400 without buyer_id (line 855-856), 404 when no held deposit exists (delegated to forfeit_deposit helper). ✓

Scheduler registration confirmed: backend.err.log shows 'Scheduler initialized with 10 jobs' across multiple restarts. storage_close_job wrapped at scheduler.py:744-756 with IntervalTrigger(minutes=5), id='process_ended_storage_auctions'. process_ended_storage_auctions in scheduled_jobs.py:378 is async. ✓

Email functions are coroutines with correct param order (buyer,auction,facility,pricing) and (facility,auction,buyer). Per-payment-method branching (stripe/cash/etransfer) executes without exceptions for all 3 methods. ✓
Regression intact: GET /api/storage-auctions still returns list. POST /api/storage-auctions/{id}/bid with deposit_required=true correctly returns 402 with deposit_required marker. ✓

rca of the issue: No bugs requiring fixes. Minor type-hint drift in two email functions: declared `-> bool` but fallback path returns a dict when SendGrid is unconfigured. Mitigation: align return type or coerce to bool. Not blocking — caller code does not rely on the return value beyond truthiness.
